invariants.title: The same pull never lands twice: a repeated hash is refused, naming the pull that holds it.
Every pull records the brief it was made under, and it is mandatory at the door.
A verdict carries a reason a person can overrule, or it is refused.
An unjudged row is a distinct state from any verdict, and is queryable as such.
Only a person promotes. The act is refused to agents whatever their role.
A promoted row records what it became; a promoted row is never re-judged or re-promoted.
A staged row is counted in no pipeline, coverage or campaign statistic.
Rows are never edited: a wrong pull is discarded and staged again from a fresh read.
A discard keeps rows that already became accounts, so those accounts keep their provenance.
A promoted account is held to the curated list's own gate: why_them and source_url, from the verdict.
Every write is a logged act with an actor; refusals are logged; reads are not.
